about_the_game:
Become the most legendary empress in Chinese history and navigate the treacherous imperial court: forge alliances, crush enemies, tame powerful ministers, and even shatter the chains of convention to establish a magnificent empire that reflects your rule!

● MULTIPLE BRANCHING PATHS: GO SHAPE YOUR FATE

Explore over 100 divergent storylines, where your survival hinges on your choices. Amidst these life-or-death trials, your only tools are wit, bravery, and emotional acumen. Will they be enough to see you through to the end?

● BE THE PROTAGONIST: AN INTERACTIVE DRAMA OF POWER AND STRATEGY

Step into a cinematic world of ancient power struggles from a thousand years ago, where every decision shapes your fate. This interactive experience immerses you in court intrigue, making the battle for power feel real and relentless.

● IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE: 4K TANG DYNASTY THAT COMES TO LIFE

Experience the splendor of ancient Chinese imperial courts in breathtaking 4K visuals, immersing yourself in the vibrant culture and artistic wonders of the East—inviting you to explore a world where every detail echoes the grandeur of tradition.

● TANG DYNASTY UNLEASHED: UNCOVER THE WILDEST SECRETS OF HISTORY

Within these palace walls, the strictest rules conceal the darkest desires—from secret bonds between a prince and a male bard, to a princess and her hidden lover. Ghosts haunt the cold palace, while sparks fly between a female official and a handsome attendant... And you will be the one to unravel it all.

● TONS OF EASTER EGGS: EXCLUSIVE ACHIEVEMENTS AWAIT

Uncover hidden stories and truths as you navigate. Beyond the main story, countless secrets await. Delve into untold histories, discover how others truly perceive you—who’s genuine, and who’s just acting? Who’s being played, and who’s the mastermind?

● PERSONALITY REPORT: DISCOVER YOURSELF, CONNECT BETTER

Each decision you make shapes a unique version of you. At the end, you'll receive a personalized report. It’s a chance to discover yourself and see how you connect with your friends.

● ELITE TEAM: DRIVEN BY PURPOSE, UNITED BY PASSION

From the creators of The Invisible Guardian, a British Academy Film Awards-winning title, NEW ONE STUDIO brings its signature craftsmanship and storytelling expertise to this immersive interactive experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Step into the shoes of China's most legendary empress and experience her extraordinary life in this high-risk, full-motion video journey. Navigate desire, darkness, schemes, betrayal, and redemption with wisdom and courage. Seek rebirth and revenge, but face tough moral choices. How far will you go?
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
